description: Define the four Strapi content types mirroring the engine config model (design §3) — Flow, Jdm, Connection, Environment — plus their components, with Draft & Publish enabled on Flow/Jdm/Connection and a secret-denylist lifecycle guard on Connection. Depends on FEAT-001 (the scaffold). The two editor fields are wired in FEAT-004; here `tree`/`doc` use the base type:'json' so the schema is complete and the app builds without the custom-field components yet.
steps: Flow content type (cms/src/api/flow/content-types/flow/schema.json + generated routes/controllers/services) per design §3.1: fields flowId (uid), method (enum GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE), path (string, regex ^/[A-Za-z0-9/_{}.-]+$ <=512), tree (json for now — the rule-engine.flow-canvas custom field replaces it in FEAT-004), fixtures (repeatable component flow-fixture), environment (relation manyToOne -> environment), note (text), engineVersion (integer, read-only in admin), lastPublishStatus (enum none/validated/published/failed), lastValidation (json). Enable draftAndPublish:true.
flow-fixture component (cms/src/components/flow/flow-fixture.json) per §3.1.1: name (string, required), input (json, required), mocks (json, nullable/optional), expect (json, nullable/optional).

Jdm content type (cms/src/api/jdm/...) per §3.2: jdmId (uid), doc (json for now — rule-engine.jdm-editor custom field in FEAT-004), environment (relation -> environment), note (text), engineVersion (integer, read-only). Enable draftAndPublish:true.

Connection content type (cms/src/api/connection/...) per §3.3: key (uid), type (enum postgres/valkey/rest), settings (component, credential-free discrete shape by type — §3.3.1), secretRef (string <=256), resilience (component resilience-policy), environment (relation -> environment), engineVersion (integer, read-only). Enable draftAndPublish:true. Create the settings components matching the driver shape: postgres {host,port(int default 5432),database,user,sslmode(enum disable/require/verify-full default disable),pool{maxConns,minConns}}, rest {baseURL,headers(json)}, valkey {addr,db(int default 0),pool{maxConns,minConns}}. Create resilience-policy component authoring timeoutMs (int >=0) + retry.maxAttempts (int >=1) in human units (transform converts to Go ns in FEAT-003). NEVER author a dsn field.

Environment content type (cms/src/api/environment/...) per §3.4: name (uid, e.g. dev/staging/prod), adminApiBaseUrl (string), operatorTokenRef (string), payloadEnv (string, default ""). NO draftAndPublish (it is CMS metadata selecting which engine deployment to target). Document that name is NOT the payload env.

Connection lifecycle guard (cms/src/api/connection/content-types/connection/lifecycles.ts): beforeCreate/beforeUpdate reject any settings key matching the case-insensitive denylist password,pwd,secret,token,apikey,dsn (design §3.3.1) — the CMS-side superset of the engine edge guard. Reject with a clear validation error naming the offending key. This is the first of the two secret guards (the transform in FEAT-003 is the second).
acceptance_criteria: All four content types load: `npm run build` succeeds and `npm run develop` boots far enough to register the schemas without a schema error (build success is the gating check — do not require a running server with a DB).
Flow, Jdm, Connection have draftAndPublish:true in their schema.json; Environment does not.
Connection settings components exist for postgres/rest/valkey with the exact discrete driver keys from §3.3.1 and NO dsn field anywhere.
The Connection lifecycle guard rejects a settings object containing any of password/pwd/secret/token/apikey/dsn (case-insensitive) — covered by a vitest unit test over the guard function.
flow-fixture component has mocks/expect nullable (not required).

findings:
DONE. Four content types + components under cms/src, lifecycle secret guard, and a vitest denylist suite. All three gates green.

CONTENT TYPES (api names later features key off — api::<singular>.<singular>):
- api::flow.flow (collectionName 'flows'), draftAndPublish:true. Attrs: flowId(uid, required), method(enum GET/POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE, required), path(string, required, maxLength 512, regex ^/[A-Za-z0-9/_{}.-]+$), tree(json — PLAIN for now; FEAT-004 repoints to custom field rule-engine.flow-canvas), fixtures(repeatable component flow.flow-fixture), environment(relation manyToOne -> api::environment.environment), note(text), engineVersion(integer), lastPublishStatus(enum none/validated/published/failed, default none), lastValidation(json). engineVersion/lastValidation are plain fields here (admin read-only chrome is a FEAT-004 admin-layer concern, not a schema primitive).
- api::jdm.jdm (collectionName 'jdms'), draftAndPublish:true. Attrs: jdmId(uid, required), doc(json — PLAIN for now; FEAT-004 repoints to rule-engine.jdm-editor), environment(relation -> environment), note(text), engineVersion(integer).
- api::connection.connection (collectionName 'connections'), draftAndPublish:true. Attrs: key(uid, required), type(enum postgres/valkey/rest, required), settings(DYNAMICZONE of the 3 per-type settings components — see note), secretRef(string, maxLength 256), resilience(component connection.resilience-policy), environment(relation -> environment), engineVersion(integer). NO dsn field anywhere.
- api::environment.environment (collectionName 'environments'), draftAndPublish:FALSE (CMS metadata). Attrs: name(uid, required), adminApiBaseUrl(string), operatorTokenRef(string), payloadEnv(string, default ""). NOTE: name selects the target engine deployment/base-URL+token; it is NOT the payload env — payloadEnv is the value sent in the admin body's env field (default "").

SETTINGS SHAPE DECISION (load-bearing for FEAT-003 transform): design §3.3 calls settings 'polymorphic by type'. Strapi has no single-component polymorphism, so settings is a DYNAMICZONE accepting [connection.postgres-settings, connection.rest-settings, connection.valkey-settings]. Consequence: at the API/data layer each settings entry is an ARRAY of component objects, and each object carries a __component discriminator (e.g. 'connection.postgres-settings'). The FEAT-003 publish-transform must read settings[0], strip __component/id, and emit the flat credential-free object the admin API expects (host/port/database/user/sslmode/pool for postgres; baseURL/headers for rest; addr/db/pool for valkey). It must NOT forward the Strapi wrapper keys.

COMPONENTS (all under cms/src/components):
- flow.flow-fixture (flow/flow-fixture.json): name(string, required), input(json, required), mocks(json, OPTIONAL/nullable), expect(json, OPTIONAL/nullable). mocks/expect intentionally NOT required.
- connection.postgres-settings: host(string), port(int default 5432), database(string), user(string), sslmode(enum disable/require/verify-full default disable), pool(component connection.pool). NO dsn.
- connection.rest-settings: baseURL(string), headers(json). Non-secret headers only; auth tokens ride in secretRef.
- connection.valkey-settings: addr(string), db(int default 0), pool(component connection.pool).
- connection.pool (shared): maxConns(int), minConns(int). Mirrors the driver's nested pool.{maxConns,minConns} — flat poolMax deliberately NOT authored (design §3.3.1).
- connection.resilience-policy: timeoutMs(int >=0), retry(component connection.retry-policy). HUMAN units; FEAT-003 transform converts timeoutMs ms -> Go-cased ns Timeout and retry.maxAttempts -> Retry.MaxAttempts.
- connection.retry-policy (split out because Strapi nests a component, not an inline object): maxAttempts(int >=1).

LIFECYCLE GUARD: cms/src/api/connection/content-types/connection/lifecycles.ts (Strapi auto-loads it, colocated with schema). Exports a pure, testable API that FEAT-003's second (transform) guard can reuse: SECRET_DENYLIST = ['password','pwd','secret','token','apikey','dsn'] (exact order), findDeniedSecretKey(settings) -> first offending key or null (RECURSIVE over objects AND arrays — needed because settings is a dynamiczone array of nested component objects; matches on key.toLowerCase() === a denylist entry, so 'apiKey'/'DSN' are caught but 'apikeyId'/'passwordless' are NOT), and assertNoSecretInSettings(data) which throws @strapi/utils errors.ValidationError naming the offending key. beforeCreate/beforeUpdate both call it. Guard is CMS-side SUPERSET of the engine edge guard (adds 'pwd', keeps blanket 'dsn').

TEST: cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/server/tests/connection-denylist-guard.test.ts (13 tests) imports the guard directly and asserts: exact denylist, clean postgres object passes, each denied key rejected (incl. dsn), case-insensitive matching, nested-object + nested-array detection, substring keys NOT flagged, and null/absent settings no-op. Runs alongside the FEAT-001 sanity placeholder.

PLUGIN STATE: config/plugins.ts rule-engine stays enabled:false (unchanged) — FEAT-002 adds no plugin entry (index.ts) files, so flipping it would make Strapi fail to load an entry-less plugin. FEAT-004 flips it when admin/server code lands. The four content types live under src/api/ and load regardless of the plugin flag.
